evals.name: Ecosystem Health & Hard Limits Audit
evals.prompt: Run a full health and security audit on the ai-agent-toolkit repository and output an ecosystem scorecard.
evals.expected_output: Comprehensive audit report inspecting all skills, rules, deprecated workflows, and domain isolation with a visual scorecard.
assertions: Executes scripts/audit_toolkit.py across the repository root
Audits line counts for skills (must be <= 500 lines) and character limits for rules (<= 12,000 chars)
Flags deprecated standalone workflows slated for retirement on November 1, 2026
Validates open-source security isolation ensuring zero proprietary domain leaks

evals.name: Global Parity & Token Budget Audit
evals.prompt: Audit ~/.gemini/ global configuration against the toolkit to check for orphan skills and token budget limits in GEMINI.md.
evals.expected_output: Global audit report analyzing GEMINI.md character count against the 12,000 limit and identifying orphan global skills.
assertions: Checks character count of ~/.gemini/GEMINI.md against the 12,000 character limit
Identifies orphan skills or stale rules in ~/.gemini/ not present in the toolkit
Outputs structured visual health scorecard with overall ecosystem percentage
